authority: Explicit user instruction to replace existing models during Step11, retrain on historical data where needed, use new models in production and compare against real data without parallel shadow mode.
predeployment_requirements: Valid target and sufficient causally available training inputs for the method
Historical retraining on corrected numerical source when needed
Compatible readers, required normal tests and exact-source review
after_deployment: Retain actual emitted production predictions before targets occur
Score against real original observations after maturity
Report calibration/skill/coverage/subgroups and unavailable evidence separately
Use old artifacts for rollback and historical replay without a parallel shadow schedule
unsupported_targets: Record exact missing input or numerical training-support dependency and explicit target-specific raw fallback/withholding; no fabricated model or probability, no blanket delay of valid replacements.
collection_scope: Existing authorized collection and retained historical data only; model-replacement instruction does not expand cloud-access authorization.
